test_demo_notebook: test the habitat-lab demo notebook by running pytest on notebooks/habitat-lab-demo.ipynb
run_habitat_get_config: run habitat.get_config to load a YAML config file for pointnav navigation benchmarks
use_habitat_config_read_write: use habitat.config.read_write as a context manager to modify config values like dataset split
check_PointNavDatasetV1_paths: check if PointNavDatasetV1 config paths exist before running the Matterport3D validation dataset tests
run_pytest_main_programmatically: run pytest.main programmatically with nbval-lax to validate a Jupyter notebook from a test function
